mask_definition: FCC and interior in BOTH frames, or all THREE for common masks; >=10/20/30 A from GB and each occupied outer grain Y surface
definition: ID matched all-axis orthogonal MIC; no alignment or drift subtraction. Relative median = top component median minus bottom component median. Geometry test separately uses non-ID matching.
coefficient_definition: Lx=c FULL a[1,-2,1] along bottom X, or 2c times (a/2)[1,-2,1]; Y/Z residual retained

77->80.scope: all 11052 atoms; Ni species; grain side preserved; all-axis periodic geometry
77->80.search: 160 uniformly spaced X seeds, best 12 refined by mean nearest X residual, max 60 iterations; not certified global optimization; no Y/Z fitting

80->84.scope: all 11052 atoms; Ni species; grain side preserved; all-axis periodic geometry
80->84.search: 160 uniformly spaced X seeds, best 12 refined by mean nearest X residual, max 60 iterations; not certified global optimization; no Y/Z fitting

unreflected_77_to_84_control.scope: all 11052 atoms; Ni species; grain side preserved; all-axis periodic geometry
unreflected_77_to_84_control.search: fixed ID-measured common 20 A grain mean translations; no geometry fitting

limitations: No confidence intervals: spatially correlated atoms; sensitivity is descriptive.
MIC cannot infer path or half-box-exceeding motion. Median is nonlinear and need not add.
Fixed z0=0 reflection is origin dependent; no adjustable plane or fitted Z tested. Opposite mean Z alone is not mirror evidence.
Nearest geometry is a lower-bound relaxation of assignment at tested translation. Only unique mutual subset is verified one-to-one if full bijection fails; no forced permutation.
No arbitrary tolerance defines pure X or mirror: transverse residuals and geometry distributions/counts explicit.
CNA and grain sides do not independently index supplied orientations; no DSC/Burgers vector inference.
